issues.on_page: Intergovernmental revenues 508,418; Street schedule p16 'State of Nebraska-motor vehicle fee' 18,918
issues.issue: The statement remainder 489,841 still contains Street's state motor vehicle fee 18,918, while detail[37] records that same line as motor vehicle tax. The same money has a different category in receipts and detail. Under the rule that motor vehicle fees are motor vehicle tax, the remainder could be split the same way homestead and pro-rate were.

The extractor rules list rural fire contracts under charges for services/fees, but the statement (p6) counts this line inside Intergovernmental revenues. Defensible either way; it already has a review note.
